about_the_game:
Here, medical accidents are plenty — but luckily, the dead don’t talk.
What truly matters is profitability, and for that, Management is more than happy to throw you straight into the deep end, as long as patients keep flooding in.

As an amateur doctor, with no experience and no diploma, you’ll find yourself in France, 1999 — right in the middle of a relentless mental challenge:

Check, examine, diagnose, and prescribe.
Tasks you’ll have to learn on the spot, for better or worse.

As the Director likes to say:
"There’s no money without breaking a few eggs."

Every patient is a potential fraudster — you’ve been warned!

Fake name, expired card, missing insurance? It’s up to YOU, as the Doctor and the last line of defense, to keep the undesirables away from treatment.

Management is watching you…

Holster your rudimentary tools — medicine is serious business!

Fortunately, Management won’t leave you defenseless.
As a fine 20th-century Doctor, armed with the very best in French medical technology, you’ll gain access to true diagnostic weapons. Among them:

  • A rechargeable-battery flashlight (fancy, right?)

  • A thermometer that goes beep beep

  • A modular-interface stethoscope (don’t ask what that means)

  • A suspicious-smell sniffer

  • A portable pustule scanner

For every patient, the right treatment.

Across a wide range of increasingly absurd illnesses, you’ll have to identify the correct symptoms and deliver a diagnosis — one that will always weigh on your paycheck.

Don’t slip up… or you may find your unfortunate patient featured in the obituary section of tomorrow’s paper.

Scheming, lies, bribes, and retaliation—who said being a doctor was an easy job?

When you joined the prestigious Last Breath Clinic, you shouldn't have expected an easy life. Aside from the impatience of some patients and the increasingly demanding nature of the work, you'll have to face real dilemmas that could change your life... or put it on hold indefinitely.

It's up to you to make the right choices, juggle your various key contacts, and find the loopholes that will allow you to end your job in the best possible way.

name: Prescribe and Pray

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Who said being a doctor was an easy job? In Prescribe and Pray, you're the Doctor! Check the patient's identity, diagnose their (often bizarre) illness, and issue their prescription. All without making a mistake! So, are you up to the challenge?
